event_name: Muckleshoot Casino Resort NHRA Northwest Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 73 degrees, relative humidity 57 percent, barometer 30.03 inches, adjusted
altitude 1,673 feet, track temperature 111 degrees.

Leah Pruett is 26 - 36 in Rd. 3 races.

Hart is 0 - 2 against Pruett this year.

Hart is 5 - 3 against Pruett in prior events. 

Hart with a tick advantage, but never trailed from there on for the win.  She is just off her quickest pass of
the weekend for the win.  She is advancing to her 28th final round and third this season.

This is the 85th meeting between Doug Kalitta and Antron Brown and that is the 2nd most between any two TF
racers. (Schumacher & Kalitta - 98)

In their 83 previous races Antron has "left first: 57 times.

Brown is 44 - 39 against Kalitta in prior events. 

Brown with the starting line advantage, but lost traction and pedaled it but couldn't get it to hook up.

Kalitta will give up lane choice to Pruett in the final.  He is advancing to his sixth final round this season
and 132nd of his career.
